preconditions.description: The length of the encoded word s is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The encoded word s consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The length of the decoded word is equal to the length of the encoded word.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in decode(s))
postconditions.description: The decoded word consists only of lowercase English letters.
Encoding the decoded word results in the original encoded word.
